title: Flag repeat COD orders by phone
persona: Snack brand owner who calls repeat COD buyers to thank them and confirm; short messages, Hinglish.
opening: jo customer pehle bhi order kar chuka hai aur ab COD pe order kiya hai, un orders ko mark kar do taaki main call kar saku

facts.how to know repeat: same phone number se pehle koi bhi order aaya ho, prepaid ya COD
facts.which orders: sirf COD wale naye order mark karne hain

success: the repeat COD orders are marked in the orders list
the plan is said in plain words before anything is built, with no field names or types
ends by asking whether to build
must_not: a rule that writes a value into every row
jargon such as "boolean" or "set_fields" in what the owner reads
